description_elimfilters: ELIMFILTERS® ET90500 Turbine-series fuel/water separator housing and element. TURBOCORE™ three-stage coalescing media removes water and fine particulate from diesel fuel before it reaches the engine, protecting injectors from corrosion and abrasive wear.
